name: Hugo Spencer
original_name: ヒューゴ・スペンサー
source:
[i]“If I want to be like the man I admire, then I must become a full-fledged knight.”[/i]

[i]Devoted and Defeated[/i]

A cadet in the Wings of Garuda. Serious and disciplined, his admiration for Crius led to him choosing the path of a knight. Due to his father's profession as a cardinal, he earnestly looks after others. He's normally level-headed, but a single misstep can also lead to some unpredictable behaviors.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=hugo]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
